models_evaluated: Diabetes Help GPT (prompt-engineered custom GPT layer over GPT)

links.outcome: Accuracy and citation inclusion of curated-source diabetes GPT responses
links.effect: Overall accuracy 91.7%, citations included in 93.3% of responses, rationale in 100%; accuracy lower for insulin-related items (82.3%).
links.quote: Diabetes Help GPT showed high overall accuracy (91.7 %), with 100 % rationale inclusion, 93.3 % citations, 84.8 % disclaimers, and minimal emoji use (13.3 %).

links.outcome: Accuracy bias across question categories/formats assessed by bias assessment
links.effect: No accuracy bias was detected in the bias assessment.

unlisted_practices: Prompt-engineered custom GPT built on curated expert-selected sources with disclaimers and rationale in every response

screen.reason: The study designs a prompt-engineered custom GPT tool for diabetes care and evaluates its performance on a benchmark set of 420 questions without comparing deployment practices or safeguards.
